## Post Call Summary — Ankit (ankit@jeavio.com)

**Links**
- **Salesforce Account:** [Jeavio](https://cursor.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Account/001Hr00002CS7WeIAL/view)
- **Gong Call:** [Cursor Introduction: Jon <> Ankit](https://us-4796.app.gong.io/call?id=1101330611875249983)
- **Primary Team ID (best guess):** 4073294
- **Other Team ID(s):** 2715293
- **Any Usage (last 30 days):** **Primary:** 4073294 — [View usage](https://anyusage.fieldsphere.app/?teamId=4073294&start_date=2026-02-14&end_date=2026-03-15). **Team 2715293:** [View usage](https://anyusage.fieldsphere.app/?teamId=2715293&start_date=2026-02-14&end_date=2026-03-15)

---

### Topics discussed
- Evaluation of Cursor and other AI tools for Jeavio's engineering org
- Team vs Enterprise plans: pricing, usage controls, analytics
- Current usage limits and cost structure under Team plan
- Enterprise benefits: pooled usage, granular controls, API access, project-based billing
- ROI measurement and spend control for AI tool adoption
- Flexibility and volume-based discounting on Enterprise

### Main pain point
Team quickly hits usage limits on the Team plan, leading to downsizing licenses and considering alternatives; lack of granular spend controls and visibility makes it hard to manage costs and justify ROI.

### Promised next steps
- Jon to send Ankit an email with cost simulation for Team vs Enterprise based on current usage, including overages and discounting.
- Ankit to review with leadership as part of broader AI tooling evaluation.
